«Bulat» from TsBST to the front line

Portable UAV detector made by 3mx (OOO «Trimiks»RussianООО «Тримикс»), a company under sanctions. It is sold online and through dealers, bought by state agencies under 3 contracts and handed to military units by a foundation that works with TsBST and by the maker itself.

What this does not show

  • No document records 3mx as a formal member of a TsBST programme. Its link to TsBST rests on the posts and statements cited on its card.
  • 2 further marketplace listings without an archived copy of the page are left out.
  • Fond «Nasha Pravda»'s accounts show it bought «Bulat» for transfer to units, but name no seller. Who sold them to it is not documented.
  • The 17 handovers are Fond «Nasha Pravda»'s own reports. None is confirmed by the receiving unit or an independent source, and the post date is not always the handover date.
  • No document shows where 3mx obtained «Bulat». The line from the product to the donor is dotted for that reason.
  • The 1 handovers are 3mx's own reports. None is confirmed by the receiving unit or an independent source, and the post date is not always the handover date.

Every company, listing, contract and handover here comes from an archived document. Listings and handovers are as of the dates shown; 5 listings and 18 handovers are on file.
